0b2e06d3c0e5fff3.text: Your knight captures the rook on d5, even though a pawn guards it. Good, equal, or bad trade?

0c97009b5f6f0dc9.text: Move the pawn to the star. Its first move can go one square or two!

0d0492bbe105e2c8.text: Move the rook straight across to the star.

0f10031f5a61d62c.text: Checkmate in one! Move your queen right next to the black king.

10c942543e1a2874.text: When your king is in check, there are 3 ways out: move it to safety, block the attack, or capture the attacker. Let's practise all three!

12607f6d1485d38e.text: Move your king out of check — nothing can block or capture this rook here.

149113692109d6b1.text: Move your knight so it attacks the bishop on c4.

161305d8bada154a.text: A pawn now blocks the diagonal. Is your king in check?

179afc6998f7ee50.text: Checkmate in one! Your king guards the flight squares.

191e158590e98ce7.text: The queen moves straight or diagonal, not like that!

1b52f185a7648edc.text: The rook is hungry. Gobble up the pawn!

1b75351718266095.text: That piece can't move there! This one is tricky. Want an easier one?

1c245b2c8485f46b.text: Move the queen straight up to the star.

1c36b4a1496c5ccf.text: Watch the pawn move forward. On its very first step it can go one square or two!

1c917dca930ca0b1.text: The black rook is coming for your knight! The knight can hop away to safety, or a friend could guard it.

238d6cfdf408a78b.text: The pawn is about to transform! Which piece should it become?

2cf13bf512ac47ce.text: Tap every square the pawn attacks — the knight and the bishop are both there.

2f5fd132ab9bb1bb.text: Your queen is very powerful. Find a move that attacks the knight on f6.

327600e69c488021.text: Move the king one step up to the star.

32f5411f80227cb6.text: The knight jumps in an L shape: two squares one way, then one more to the side. It can jump right over anyone standing in between!

3428dadb62fce506.text: Want to show me you already know Queen?

34c1d00f33b1ae11.text: Move your bishop so it gives check to the black king.

360352facc1570cf.text: Your king and the queenside rook are both still home, with a clear path between them. Can your king castle queenside right now?

3761085eb6c648b5.text: The pawn only moves straight ahead (and captures diagonally)!

38aa3401b69130cf.text: Checkmate! The queen checks the king, and every square around it is covered.

3a54cc36b3dcb5e8.text: Your king is in check from a bishop far away. Tap every safe square for it.

3ab59282ca6ede3d.text: Capture the checking knight with your pawn!

3bf39d766af0bb03.text: Black's pawn just rushed two squares past your pawn on h5. Can you capture it en passant right now?

3c95b7e7358fed17.text: The bishop is hungry. Gobble up the pawn!

3d15acdbd3a3823f.text: Your rook captures the queen on h1. Is this trade good, equal, or bad?

3f0a929fba0f07b9.text: The rook only moves in straight lines!

400206411896f5c8.text: Watch the king take one careful step in every direction.

43eb3394f966edb5.text: A rock blocks one path, a pawn waits on another. Tap every square the bishop can reach.

44332d4428c20f67.text: The queen is starving! Capture every piece before the moves run out.

4573449517f801cd.text: A check! The black rook attacks your king along the open file.

46f583e954b83ad7.text: Watch the rook go to every green dot. Straight lines, any distance!

47727af8c179c8cf.text: Move your rook so it gives check to the black king.

49f4af130260e02b.text: The pawn only moves straight ahead (and captures diagonally)! This one is tricky. Want an easier one?

4ac4c6b0160c7a44.text: Move your bishop so it attacks the knight on a5.

4b330b9fbbfe054e.text: The bishop (black) is undefended. Capture it for free with your queen!

4bd878e72d9bbc0b.text: Help the rook grab both stars in the corners.

4ca099e8cb420260.text: A black knight jumps into position to attack your king. Is your king in check?

4cbfd13ad6e98fe1.text: Find the checkmate in one move — your queen and king work together.

4da2b64093b81c6c.text: Your king is in check from the bishop. Tap every square where it is safe.

4db20e5d1123106f.text: Want to show me you already know King?

4f17d54192bb3bd1.text: A black rook sits on a different line, far from your king. Is your king in check?

4f20c0972a31d545.text: Nothing attacks your bishop. Is it hanging?

4f2ac38dab45baaf.text: The king's longest walk yet. Stay safe all the way to the star.

51487da2d3173f3e.text: Your knight (a1) is trapped and the black rook is attacking it! Move your bishop so it guards the knight.

516ff7ff2354ba82.text: Eight pawns each! Race to transform first, or capture every piece.

5171c44fb039f308.text: Move the pawn forward, one square, to the star.

51ff569ed050be52.text: Your pawn is blocked straight ahead, but it can still capture on either diagonal. Tap every square it can reach.

551c4ac833644a89.text: Walk the king to the star, one step at a time.

552c59fd6622c5e4.text: Look at the piece in the orange box.

56d310d75873db3b.text: The bishop only visits squares of one colour. Can it reach the star?

5825b76d968e3613.text: Tap every square the rook can reach from here.

58e2feb33d7ba5bd.text: Checkmate in one! Your queen and king team up.

5a3b7be23e69cced.text: When a king is attacked, that's CHECK — danger! Your king must get to safety right away. Owl will teach you to spot it, and how to give check yourself.

5a5c4823bb0ab5ee.text: Block the check! Move your rook between your king and the bishop.

5aae3b3e7b79e893.text: A rock blocks one landing spot. Tap every square the knight can jump to.

5b3e971e6cebdbd7.text: Castling is a special move! The king and a rook move together: the king jumps two squares toward a rook that hasn't moved yet, and that rook hops right over to stand beside him. It's the only time two pieces move in one turn!

5bf3b03593700011.text: Find the good trade: capture a piece worth more than your rook.

5ebe4bc2f8bd17af.text: Your rook can give check! Find the move that attacks the black king.

613fa1ea066bb8b9.text: Try it! Move your king two squares toward a rook to castle.

6307bb87c8cd8637.text: Your queen can check the black king in several ways. Find one!

66980bc257c4b8e5.text: Both rooks are still home! Castle with either one.

6758da3ed86bf7c5.text: Your king and the kingside rook haven't moved, and nothing stands between them. Can your king castle kingside right now?

695eb2f5f2b4ddfe.text: Queen Maker. Promote 10 pawns in games

69e4d764ad40ad28.text: A knight stands between your king and the kingside rook. Can your king castle kingside right now?

6a2cb9e6929db443.text: Your knight has more than one jump. Which move attacks the rook on b5?

6a3f2d412b01d607.text: A black bishop watches the square right next to your king. Can your king castle queenside right now?

6b5d979d100478ff.text: Your bishop can capture two different pieces. Find a good trade.

718b5feb369fb527.text: Every piece has a value: a pawn is worth 1, a knight and a bishop are worth 3, a rook is worth 5, and the queen is worth a mighty 9! Knowing this helps you decide if a trade is worth it.

72e73d01cd6f5733.text: The rook giving check isn't guarded. Capture it with your king!

752ce655c620494f.text: Your king is in check from the rook. Tap every square where it is safe.

75419446abb043eb.text: When a pawn reaches the very last row, something amazing happens: it transforms into a brand-new piece! It can become a queen, a rook, a bishop, or a knight — the powerful queen is almost always the best choice.

79181c60dd5d124e.text: The pawn on f4 is undefended. If your bishop captures it, good, equal, or bad trade?

79245dd6f6e79310.text: Checkmate in one! Your king guards your queen's checking square.

7a3a5ca52f21a22c.text: Help the bishop grab both stars, corner to corner.

7a956f407a8ed50a.text: The bishop only moves on diagonal paths! This one is tricky. Want an easier one?

7c3c11ee2ab0e2ca.text: Move your rook so it attacks the knight on d4.

7db21498caedf840.text: Checkmate in one! Your king guards the squares your rook can't reach.

7dc46a4424658841.text: The rook on h1 is guarded by a knight. If your rook captures it, good, equal, or bad trade?

7e7223b6fd3d7863.text: Move the rook straight up to the star.

7e756b18ca059a2e.text: Tap every square where the pawn could transform this move.

7eb251fc03bd449d.text: The knight must collect every star by jumping over the rocks!

8051f86109a85a59.text: Tap every square the bishop can reach. Look — they're all the same colour!

807c829677f9d61d.text: The knight (black) attacks your queen and nothing guards it. Is your queen hanging?

83287434445de3fb.text: The queen's biggest challenge yet. Collect every star around the rock.

836d606f57ab88d5.text: Black's last move was the king, not the pawn. Can your pawn on d5 capture the e5 pawn en passant right now?

840b41dbfaf4d1b2.text: Capture both pawns on the bishop's diagonals.

88ee25df294820aa.text: The queen is hungry. Gobble up the pawn!

8920e55361104927.text: The black rook is coming for your knight on b5! Move the knight to safety.

897ebe1546c69095.text: Checkmate in one! Your queen can reach the back row.

8a3520040586fac5.text: A friend blocks one line, a pawn waits on another. Tap every square the queen can reach.

8bbad92532a8d285.text: A pawn now guards your knight. Is it still hanging?

8ccf1900b5f89bf6.text: The rook's biggest challenge yet. Collect every star around the rock.

8df6d76876dfecd8.text: The bishop (black) attacks your knight and nothing guards it. Is your knight hanging?

921f3bd78d70fa34.text: The rook only moves in straight lines! This one is tricky. Want an easier one?

932d09330dc8614e.text: Want to show me you already know Knight?

938e78a20e0a1e28.text: The kingside rook already moved away from the corner. Can your king castle kingside right now?

9516834724685045.text: The king is the most important piece of all! It only steps one square at a time, in any direction, and it must always stay safe.

9535c8b9b3d759bd.text: Your king is in check! Tap every square where it can escape.

95da6a757a9f4ea8.text: Your knight jumps in an L. Tap every square it attacks from d4 — some are empty, some have pieces!

96ef7ce7a0057063.text: Help the queen grab both stars in the corners.

9870ee8460c8953d.text: Collect every star. Plan the rook's path first!

98c3b909b2429539.text: The king only steps one square at a time!

9abd9dfc3d43e587.text: Two of your pawns could catch this one — either capture works!

9b2e87fafc4b3485.text: The bishop on c3 is attacking your rook! Move your knight to capture it.

9d1ee63ca2bd1625.text: The black rook is attacking your bishop. Move the bishop to safety.

9f8947614a789857.text: Tap every square the king can step to.

a07dd6c6445f78d6.text: Your knight wants to attack the bishop on d4. Which move lets it do that?

a0ab077f06be0c20.text: The black pawn is undefended. Capture it for free!

a210debde46c5f1c.text: Move the queen straight across to the star.

a23a52aedfc449b6.text: Tap every square the knight can jump to.

a30e5a07a0148c30.text: Only the queenside rook is still home. Castle queenside!

a36b5d0f08faf1f8.text: Your knight (a1) still can't move. Save it — block the attack, or capture the attacking rook!

a7a3724dcfdc14a3.text: The pawn already made its first move. Now it moves one square at a time. Reach the star.

a8fe67afe19c00d2.text: The rook attacks in straight lines. Tap every square it attacks from d1.

aad306bf7027209c.text: Your king is in check. Every green dot is a square where it would be safe.

aae68c79484b2acc.text: The bishop is starving! Capture every piece before the moves run out.

ab756c3437be875e.text: The rook (black) attacks your rook on a4, but your other rook guards it. Is your rook on a4 hanging?

ab9e9edbdbe431c2.text: The bishop giving check isn't guarded. Capture it with your king!

abe16277997175dc.text: Watch the bishop go to every green dot. Diagonal paths, any distance!

abf579c2849dc418.text: Checkmate in one! Your knight and pawn guard the black king's escape.

ae42edd5da98bb2b.text: Two pieces stand in your pawn's way. Move closer, then capture them both!

b1e3a550da8f6a7c.text: On its very first move, the pawn can go two squares. Reach the star!

b5a1ea747c516035.text: Want to show me you already know Rook?

b6227258c189c4ef.text: The queen combines the rook's straight lines and the bishop's diagonal paths. It is the strongest piece on the board!

b67ad4f3e3314794.text: Is your king in check from the black rook?

b6b9f41b8b7274f6.text: Sometimes a pawn rushes two squares on its very first move, right past an enemy pawn standing beside it. That's not quite fair — so, just this once, the enemy pawn may capture it anyway, as if it had only moved one square. This is called "en passant" (French for "in passing"), and it only works right away, the very next move.

b771fbd877a1c809.text: The bishop only moves on diagonal paths!

b7ca2faa0d78329b.text: The king must reach both stars, one careful step at a time, always staying safe.

b815d7a5f42862cd.text: Move the bishop the other diagonal way to the star.

ba0c9de7605a3983.text: The bishop's biggest challenge yet. Capture all four pawns.

ba163b3e52a41184.text: Want to show me you already know Pawn?

bc4714b60b42ad25.text: Watch the queen go to every green dot. Straight lines and diagonals, any distance!

be6bb26c969ccdc1.text: A friend blocks one line, a pawn waits on another. Tap every square the rook can reach.

bf0857df0cd3d2ae.text: Black's pawn just rushed two squares past your pawn on c5. Can you capture it en passant right now?

c07c549b29584fc1.text: Castle kingside! Move your king two squares to swap places with the rook.

c2af8b28172bad7e.text: Tap every square the queen can reach from here.

c2f37aa38291e6d8.text: A knight's check can never be blocked! Move your king to safety.

c3a61831ccd32486.text: One more step and the pawn transforms! Move it to the last row.

c42688b9b27fc0a8.text: Move the bishop diagonally to the star.

c4bef2da3a2358a8.text: Your king is in check from the rook. Tap every safe square for it.

c9e41d26c64f86bc.text: Checkmate in one! Your king and rook trap the black king in the corner.

ca42439e025f4065.text: Look at your knight. The black rook attacks it and nothing guards it — the knight is hanging!

cd4a4e3e207a1174.text: The knight only jumps in an L shape!

cff06c7e7378f4ef.text: Something blocks your pawn's path straight ahead. Tap every square it can still reach.

d2b083a5f363997b.text: Find the checkmate in one move — look at your rook's path to the back row.

d2fb5bf606964a42.text: The rook is starving! Capture every piece before the moves run out.

d5de695a8a19a248.text: The knight is boxed in by rocks, but knights jump right over them!

d62fa5cb58a5c769.text: Help your king escape check 10 times — by moving, blocking, or capturing!

daaac0aca7c27463.text: Move the king one step to the star.

dc0d499a54554ebc.text: The knight (black) attacks your pawn and nothing guards it. Is your pawn hanging?

dcb002cab19d8861.text: Your pawn can only capture on a diagonal, never straight ahead. Find the piece it can capture.

dd696227f422bc26.text: Tap every square the pawn attacks.

ddcbbaf9e395a5b6.text: Rocks are in the way, but the knight jumps right over them!

de639ff6e6e8a65d.text: Is your knight defended by the pawn on c3?

dfdf4aa8b99d263c.text: The knight only jumps in an L shape! This one is tricky. Want an easier one?

e35a052cedae8069.text: Want to show me you already know Bishop?

e42e1781a86ce6ae.text: The black rook is attacking your knight. Is your knight defended by the white rook on d2?

e4bb9e48623352c3.text: The only way out is to move your king — find a safe square.

e557cf151944f366.text: A black rook is giving your king check! Can your king castle kingside right now?

e6b234718c13eae9.text: Here they are in order: pawn 1, knight or bishop 3, rook 5, queen 9.

e990c2a1d71c52be.text: Watch the knight jump to every green dot. Always an L shape!

ec11ed7840ca2c04.text: A black bishop attacks your king along the diagonal. Is your king in check?

ed28f22a74edb145.text: Checkmate in one! Your king guards the checking square.

eeb2451c3da44d09.text: The bishop only moves on diagonal paths, but it can go as far as it likes! It always stays on squares of one colour.

f0a5d4397c9a2479.text: The black rook is coming for your knight! Move the knight to safety.

f1506b0713ed8dae.text: Only the kingside rook is still home. Castle kingside!

f322295c32257aed.text: Move the pawn to the last row. Push forward, or capture the rook — either way it transforms!

f388da2cb2f411e4.text: The queen must capture every pawn before one of them transforms!

f3da049f0e27dadf.text: Checkmate in one! Your knight guards the squares for your queen.

f4f1ad08533ac5f1.text: Checkmate in one! Your rook delivers check along the open file.

f507dcb8aea2e971.text: The knight (black) is undefended. Capture it with your bishop — a free piece is always a good trade!

f5428de634a1f2cd.text: Look at the pawn. Is it about to transform into a new piece?

f573007f46028b19.text: Block the check! Move your bishop between your king and the rook.

f576d146d21aec6e.text: Watch the pawn move all the way to the last row. There, it transforms!

f581197b2472fe74.text: Collect every star. Plan the bishop's diagonal path first!

f63def49ed125bf3.text: The king only steps one square at a time! This one is tricky. Want an easier one?

f703dbbccc02eb1b.text: The pawn on h1 is guarded by a knight. If your rook captures it, good, equal, or bad trade?

f773ab68635d273c.text: A piece waits on the diagonal. Capture it, then keep going to the star!

f918ad28c539fbf2.text: Watch the pawn. It attacks both diagonal squares in front of it!

f949542761ca45c0.text: The knight on c3 is guarded by a pawn. If your knight captures it, good, equal, or bad trade?

fadf634a171e4b4e.text: Move your king out of check.

fb1b99bbf372e0ca.text: Four pawns each! Be the first to transform into a queen, or capture every enemy.

fb704562cd8c3ce4.text: Collect both stars. Plan the knight's jumps!

fba09874a22568d8.text: Jump the knight to the star.

fc057da552c199fa.text: Your rook captures the queen! You give up a rook (worth 5) to win a queen (worth 9) — a great trade!

fd78f2bcb79cc4fe.text: The pawn on c3 is guarded by another pawn. If your knight captures it, good, equal, or bad trade?

fe315ad53b36c322.text: You earned the Queen Maker badge!

fe48de8395bb293f.text: Move your knight so it gives check to the black king.
